name: Ciplactin Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About CIPLACTIN TABLET

CIPLACTIN TABLET contains cyproheptadine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used in the management of allergic conditions such as seasonal and perineal rhinitis, hay fever, skin rashes, and allergic conjunctivitis.

Perennial rhinitis refers to specific allergens that cause an allergic reaction year-round, such as pet hair or dander, food allergies, or medicines. Whereas, seasonal allergies typically occur with weather changes or environmental changes such as pollen, insects, moisture, dryness, fungi, mold, etc.

CIPLACTIN TABLET is not recommended for debilitated patients above 65 years of age with renal, hepatic, or cardiac conditions. CIPLACTIN TABLET must be used in pregnant women only if recommended by your doctor. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mothers.

The medicine should be used with caution in adolescents and children (above 7 years of age) only. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects include dizziness, drowsiness, and high fever. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Seasonal (occurring during a specific season) and perennial rhinitis (occurring year-round)
Vasomotor rhinitis (reoccurring inflammation of the mucous membrane in the nose)
Allergic conjunctivitis (eye inflammation caused by allergy)
Urticaria (hives) and angioedema (swelling beneath the skin)
Amelioration of allergic reactions to blood or plasma (allergic severe reactions after blood or plasma transfusions)
Cold urticaria (skin reaction to cold)
Dermatographia (a condition causing raised red lines after a scratch)
It is also used as adjuvant therapy for serious allergic reactions

Manages allergic conditions in children (above 7 years of age) and adults, such as:

It is also used as adjuvant therapy for serious allergic reactions
mechanismOfAction:
How CIPLACTIN TABLET Works

CIPLACTIN TABLET manages allergic reactions by binding with certain receptors and blocking them from binding with histamine in the body. Histamine is a mediator found in our body that is responsible for causing allergic symptoms (such as inflammation, itching and irritation etc.) as a response to allergic conditions. Thereby, providing us relief from the allergic condition.
usageDetails:
How to use CIPLACTIN TABLET

Take CIPLACTIN TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken independent of meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew CIPLACTIN TABLET. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency and duration of the management for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: CIPLACTIN TABLET must be used in pregnant women only if recommended by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking CIPLACTIN TABLET.
CIPLACTIN TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking CIPLACTIN TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or feel that your mental alertness or motor coordination is affected after taking CIPLACTIN TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CIPLACTIN TABLET because it causes an additive effect, making you feel dizzy or drowsy.
CIPLACTIN TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking CIPLACTIN TABLET.
CIPLACTIN TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking CIPLACTIN TABLET.
Do not take CIPLACTIN TABLET if you are allergic to cyproheptadine.
CIPLACTIN TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with a history of bronchial asthma. Consult your doctor before taking CIPLACTIN TABLET.
CIPLACTIN TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with cardiovascular disease and hypertension. Consult your doctor before taking CIPLACTIN TABLET.

Others

CIPLACTIN TABLET is not recommended for use if you are suffering from:

Angle-closure glaucoma
Peptic ulcer
Prostatic hypertrophy or bladder neck obstruction (enlargement of the prostate gland)
Intestinal obstruction (pyloroduodenal)

Before taking CIPLACTIN TABLET, inform your doctor if you are suffering from:

Increased intraocular pressure (eye pressure)
Hyperthyroidism

Use in paediatrics:

CIPLACTIN TABLET should be used with caution in children above 7 years of age and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking CIPLACTIN TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

CIPLACTIN TABLET is not recommended in debilitated elderly patients aged over 60 years and above with decreased hepatic, renal or cardiac function. Consult your doctor before taking CIPLACTIN TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About CYPON SYRUP

CYPON SYRUP contains Cyproheptadine, Sorbitol, Tricholine which belongs to the group of medicines called Appetite stimulant. It is used as appetite enhancer. CYPON SYRUP works as an effective appetite stimulant, and it works by reducing the effect of chemical messenger that regulates appetite.

Cypon Syrup is not recommended for use if you have or had angle-closure glaucoma, stenosing peptic ulcer, symptomatic prostatic hypertrophy (enlarged prostate gland), bladder neck obstruction, signs of pyloroduodenal obstruction (gastric outlet obstruction) such as vomiting and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

CYPON SYRUP should be used with caution in pregnant women only if directed by your physician. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mothers. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects include confusion, dizziness, hallucinations, headache, irritability, nervousness, restlessness, sleepiness, tremor, vertigo and increased heart rate. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.
uses: It is used as an appetite enhancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of CYPON SYRUP
It is used as an appetite enhancer
mechanismOfAction:
How CYPON SYRUP Works

CYPON SYRUP is a combination of Cyproheptadine, Tricholine and Sorbitol, where Cyproheptadine is an appetite-stimulant which works by reducing the effect of a chemical messenger (serotonin) in the hypothalamus, a part of the brain which regulates appetite. Tricholine helps in removing bile acids from the body. The liver then produces more bile acids using cholesterol, as a result of which cholesterol level is lowered. Sorbitol acts as a syrup base and also as an osmotic laxative to relieve constipation.
usageDetails:
How to use CYPON SYRUP

Always take CYPON SYRUP as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Measure it with a measuring cup and take it by mouth. It may be taken with or without food, but it is better to take it at a fixed time as advised by your physician. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency and duration of the management for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About APTIBOOST SYRUP

APTIBOOST SYRUP is a combination of Cyproheptadine and Tricholine Citrate, which belong to the groups of medicines called antihistamines and bile acid-binding agents, respectively. It is used to manage loss of appetite, weight loss and anorexia nervosa (an eating disorder). It is also used to manage weight gain in anti-tubercular and antiretroviral regimens.

In children, it is used for gaining weight, having an inadequate dietary intake or loss of appetite or suffering from anaemia, liver disease or digestive disorders. It is also used to manage allergic rhinitis and conjunctivitis, migraine, asthma and hepatic disorders. Appetite loss is a state in which an individual has no desire to eat food, which leads to a deficiency of essential and non-essential nutrients that are required for the proper metabolism and growth of the body.

APTIBOOST SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients who have or had angle-closure glaucoma, stenosing peptic ulcer, symptomatic prostatic hypertrophy, bladder neck obstruction or pyloroduodenal obstruction. Alcohol should be avoided during APTIBOOST SYRUP management because it may increase the APTIBOOST SYRUP's action.

Before taking this medicine, tell your physician if you have a history of bronchial asthma, increased intraocular pressure, hyperthyroidism, cardiovascular disease, liver problems, kidney problems or hypertension. APTIBOOST SYRUP is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. It should be recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are drowsiness, dizziness, insomnia, blurred vision, loss of coordination, skin rash, gastrointestinal upset, nausea or vomiting. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

Alcohol should be avoided during PRACTIN EN SYRUP management because it may increase the PRACTIN EN SYRUP's action.

Before taking this medicine, tell your physician if you have a history of bronchial asthma, increased intraocular pressure, hyperthyroidism, cardiovascular disease, liver problems, kidney problems or hypertension. PRACTIN EN SYRUP is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. It should be recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are drowsiness, dizziness, insomnia, blurred vision, loss of coordination, skin rash, gastrointestinal upset, nausea or vomiting. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CYPON DROPS

CYPON DROPS is a combination of Cyproheptadine and Tricholine Citrate, which belong to the groups of medicines called antihistamines and bile acid-binding agents, respectively. It is used to manage loss of appetite, weight loss and anorexia nervosa (an eating disorder). It is also used to manage weight gain in anti-tubercular and antiretroviral regimens.

In children, it is used for gaining weight, having an inadequate dietary intake or loss of appetite or suffering from anaemia, liver disease or digestive disorders. It is also used to manage allergic rhinitis and conjunctivitis, migraine, asthma and hepatic disorders. Appetite loss is a state in which an individual has no desire to eat food, which leads to a deficiency of essential and non-essential nutrients that are required for the proper metabolism and growth of the body.

CYPON DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who have or had angle-closure glaucoma, stenosing peptic ulcer, symptomatic prostatic hypertrophy, bladder neck obstruction or pyloroduodenal obstruction. Alcohol should be avoided during CYPON DROPS management because it may increase the CYPON DROPS's action.

Before taking this medicine, tell your physician if you have a history of bronchial asthma, increased intraocular pressure, hyperthyroidism, cardiovascular disease, liver problems, kidney problems or hypertension. CYPON DROPS is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. It should be recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are drowsiness, dizziness, insomnia, blurred vision, loss of coordination, skin rash, gastrointestinal upset, nausea or vomiting. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About APTIBOOST TABLET

APTIBOOST TABLET contains cyproheptadine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used in the management of allergic conditions such as seasonal and perineal rhinitis, hay fever, skin rashes, and allergic conjunctivitis.

Perennial rhinitis refers to specific allergens that cause an allergic reaction year-round, such as pet hair or dander, food allergies, or medicines. Whereas, seasonal allergies typically occur with weather changes or environmental changes such as pollen, insects, moisture, dryness, fungi, mold, etc.

APTIBOOST TABLET is not recommended for debilitated patients above 65 years of age with renal, hepatic, or cardiac conditions. APTIBOOST TABLET must be used in pregnant women only if recommended by your doctor. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mothers.

The medicine should be used with caution in adolescents and children (above 7 years of age) only. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects include dizziness, drowsiness, and high fever. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Vasomotor rhinitis (reoccurring inflammation of the mucous membrane in the nose)
Allergic conjunctivitis (eye inflammation caused by allergy)
Urticaria (hives) and angioedema (swelling beneath the skin)
Amelioration of allergic reactions to blood or plasma (allergic severe reactions after blood or plasma transfusions)
Cold urticaria (skin reaction to cold)
Dermatographia (a condition causing raised red lines after a scratch)
It is also used as adjuvant therapy for serious allergic reactions

mechanismOfAction:
How APTIBOOST TABLET Works

APTIBOOST TABLET manages allergic reactions by binding with certain receptors and blocking them from binding with histamine in the body. Histamine is a mediator found in our body that is responsible for causing allergic symptoms (such as inflammation, itching and irritation etc.) as a response to allergic conditions. Thereby, providing us relief from the allergic condition.
usageDetails:
How to use APTIBOOST TABLET

Take APTIBOOST TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken independent of meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew APTIBOOST TABLET. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency and duration of the management for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Introduction About BIOPRON SYRUP

BIOPRON SYRUP is a combination of Cyproheptadine and Tricholine Citrate, which belong to the groups of medicines called antihistamines and bile acid-binding agents, respectively. It is used to manage loss of appetite, weight loss and anorexia nervosa (an eating disorder). It is also used to manage weight gain in anti-tubercular and antiretroviral regimens.

In children, it is used for gaining weight, having an inadequate dietary intake or loss of appetite or suffering from anaemia, liver disease or digestive disorders. It is also used to manage allergic rhinitis and conjunctivitis, migraine, asthma and hepatic disorders. Appetite loss is a state in which an individual has no desire to eat food, which leads to a deficiency of essential and non-essential nutrients that are required for the proper metabolism and growth of the body.

BIOPRON SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients who have or had angle-closure glaucoma, stenosing peptic ulcer, symptomatic prostatic hypertrophy, bladder neck obstruction or pyloroduodenal obstruction. Alcohol should be avoided during BIOPRON SYRUP management because it may increase the BIOPRON SYRUP's action.

Before taking this medicine, tell your physician if you have a history of bronchial asthma, increased intraocular pressure, hyperthyroidism, cardiovascular disease, liver problems, kidney problems or hypertension. BIOPRON SYRUP is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. It should be recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are drowsiness, dizziness, insomnia, blurred vision, loss of coordination, skin rash, gastrointestinal upset, nausea or vomiting. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About HEPTIDIN 4MG TABLET

HEPTIDIN 4MG TABLET contains cyproheptadine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used in the management of allergic conditions such as seasonal and perineal rhinitis, hay fever, skin rashes, and allergic conjunctivitis.

Perennial rhinitis refers to specific allergens that cause an allergic reaction year-round, such as pet hair or dander, food allergies, or medicines. Whereas, seasonal allergies typically occur with weather changes or environmental changes such as pollen, insects, moisture, dryness, fungi, mold, etc.

HEPTIDIN 4MG TABLET is not recommended for debilitated patients above 65 years of age with renal, hepatic, or cardiac conditions. HEPTIDIN 4MG TABLET must be used in pregnant women only if recommended by your doctor. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mothers.

The medicine should be used with caution in adolescents and children (above 7 years of age) only. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects include dizziness, drowsiness, and high fever. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How HEPTIDIN 4MG TABLET Works

HEPTIDIN 4MG TABLET manages allergic reactions by binding with certain receptors and blocking them from binding with histamine in the body. Histamine is a mediator found in our body that is responsible for causing allergic symptoms (such as inflammation, itching and irritation etc.) as a response to allergic conditions. Thereby, providing us relief from the allergic condition.
